usedFor: Shopify holds customers and orders, and 8x8 texts them with “Send SMS” when something changes.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send SMS” in 8x8
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order is worth telling the customer about, and the action can set a sender and get delivery reports.

watchOut: “Send SMS” reaches a customer outside your business, so it waits in Needs you for approval.
